open_gap_registry.item: One versioned cross-module error catalogue and correlation-ID propagation proof
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: One versioned cross-module error catalogue and automated propagation proof passes internal integration tests.

open_gap_registry.item: Circuit-breaker thresholds and retry ownership for every external dependency
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Every external dependency has bounded retry/circuit ownership and internal failure tests.

open_gap_registry.item: First-party structured logs, metrics and traces for adminapp and gateway
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Admin and gateway events reach an approved persistent collector with configured retention.

open_gap_registry.item: End-to-end correlation schema, environment levels, sampling, dashboard and alert ownership
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Dashboard, alert thresholds, delivery route and on-call acknowledgement are verified in a production-like environment.

open_gap_registry.item: Adminapp/gateway log redaction and retention periods
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Security review verifies all telemetry producers/collectors preserve the forbidden-data and redaction contract.

open_gap_registry.item: End-to-end camera-to-feedback, route and report latency/throughput/concurrency acceptance budgets
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: All PB latency, throughput, CPU and memory budgets are measured on the immutable declared environments and separately approved or revised.

open_gap_registry.item: Device-specific battery, thermal and storage numeric thresholds plus phone queue byte limit
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Battery, thermal, transient-storage and phone-queue budgets pass supported-device measurement and the phone queue gate closes.

open_gap_registry.item: Measured cloud capacity, API saturation and monthly-cost proof
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Staging shape, capacity state, API saturation and storage/full-cloud cost are measured; separate full-cloud approval is recorded.

open_gap_registry.item: Service-tier RTO/RPO and backup frequency
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: T0/T1/T2 provisional frequency, RPO and RTO are measured in isolated drills and explicitly approved or revised.

open_gap_registry.item: Actual signed backup, isolated restore receipt, deletion replay and failover proof
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: A signed bundle containing DB/object/model-config/deletion ledger/key-version is restored with the nine-step contract.

open_gap_registry.item: Approved alternate environment, credentials, network and storage capacity
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Identity-separated alternate environment capacity and traffic-transition authority are approved and drilled.

open_gap_registry.item: Supplier SLA, quota, cache TTL and approved retry/backoff for TMAP and GCS
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: TMAP/GCS supplier limits and every dependency retry/backoff/circuit rule are implemented without unsafe substitution.

open_gap_registry.item: Cross-boundary adminapp/gateway/backend outage telemetry and user-message verification
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Cross-boundary admin/gateway/backend outage messages and telemetry pass security and accessibility review.

open_gap_registry.item: Actual offline, timeout, quota, fault injection, recovery and re-synchronization evidence
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Offline, timeout, quota and re-synchronization internal fault scenarios pass while external/device execution remains separately gated.

open_gap_registry.item: Admin direct-backend path versus FP-040 protected single entry
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: A protected single-entry implementation or an explicitly approved exception is represented in current code/manifests, with admin session/high-risk-action tests and no operational workflow enablement before the boundary passes.

open_gap_registry.item: FP-035 persistent encrypted queue, chunk/resume, capacity-state and receipt-bound deletion implementation
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Current implementation and manifest evidence covers encrypted persistent retention, byte/capacity bounds, restart-safe chunk/resume, server commit/hash receipt, deletion and movement cancellation without weakening the four effective policy branches.

open_gap_registry.item: 279 formal tests and actual-device/user/TalkBack/network/socket/field/PostGIS end-to-end execution
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: The fixed source/build/config bundle has reproducible formal results for all 279 catalog entries and the required actual-device, accessibility, live-network/socket, field and PostGIS paths, with failures retained rather than promoted to PASS.

open_gap_registry.item: Repeatable integration hosts, device routing, accounts/fixtures and mock-to-live TMAP evidence
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: An isolated integration environment record fixes hosts, device routing, certificates, accounts, fixtures and build identities; mock TMAP precedes controlled live TMAP with key/quota/readiness/error evidence.

open_gap_registry.item: Security/privacy trust-boundary controls and raw-collection independent review preparation
open_gap_registry.closure_condition: Threat/privacy/access-control records cover user, admin, gateway, backend, database, model, TMAP and original-data boundaries; raw-collection notice/consent/rights review inputs are complete while external approval remains separately bounded.

open_gap_registry.item: AI/ML data, model-weight and dataset provenance/rights baseline
